passages.provision_quote: Marriage between two individuals shall not be prohibited or void on the basis of the sex, race, ethnicity or national origin of those individuals.
passages.note: Co-sponsored (House, same legislature) a constitutional amendment securing the right to marry with no anti-discrimination clause, which the annex reads as rung 2.

passages.provision_quote: Marriage between two individuals shall not be prohibited or void on the basis of the sex, race, ethnicity or national origin of those individuals.
passages.note: Co-sponsored in the current Senate term the same constitutional amendment securing the right to marry, again with no anti-discrimination clause.

rows.reasoning: She co-sponsored two separate constitutional amendments (HCR 2017 in 2024, SCR 1024 in 2025) whose operative text says marriage between two individuals shall not be prohibited or void on the basis of sex, which secures same-sex marriage in law. Neither adds an anti-discrimination clause or a religious carve-out, so each matches the rung that guarantees same-sex marriage the same benefits and protections as any other marriage.
